findings.detail: Adjacent traverses three vertex slots; virtual Quad getters alone do not implement four-node adjacency.

Inspected mean formula3*sum(signed normal angles)/sum(area) scales1/s^2 on fixed adjacency/tolerance/concavity branches; unclipped analytical mean scales1/s. No legacy correction or historical-transcription conclusion.

Original per-submesh sqrt(sum diff^2/sum analytic^2)/Nv then submesh average retained. Mixing geometrical K^2 and H^2 requires explicit normalization/scientific decision; no new aggregate proposed/adopted here.

proposal.method: Unweighted quadratic local jet, six coefficients, coface one-ring with one complete two-ring expansion on insufficient/rank/frame failure.
proposal.frame: PCA rough normal, deterministic right-handed tangent basis; source chart used only for orientation, including fitted-normal check.
proposal.numerics: Normalized physical XYZ, standard-library small SVD; proposed machine-epsilon rank/eigengap/orientation guards; report condition/residual/offset, no analytic-error-based stencil tuning.
proposal.output: Read-only nodal geometrical K/H and coverage/status, including one-sided boundary fits. No zero/analytic/diagonal fallback; no NodeAdaptive writes.
proposal.scope: Initial existing smooth single Bezier chart; legacy TRI/generator/adaptation untouched. Global aggregation remains a separate scientific gate.
